key_idea: The pseudorandomness of primes and the Möbius function over function fields can be reduced to bounding specific character sums, which is achieved by showing the associated étale sheaves are perverse and computing their vanishing cycles.
reason: The proof is a triumph of cross-field unification, recasting deep questions of analytic number theory into the algebraic geometry of polynomial spaces. While it requires a long pipeline of lemmas and some technical bookkeeping with parameters to make the estimates work, the core argument is conceptually profound and unexpected.
recognized: Sawin and Shusterman, On the Chowla and twin primes conjectures over F_q[T] (2022)
